summary: E-commerce grocery store app with barcode scanning, portfolio management, flexible quantity input for loose items (Rice, Sugar, Oil, Spices) with dynamic pricing, mobile OTP sign-in, GPS location detection, and admin panel
architectural_notes: App deployed on Internet Computer blockchain at .icp0.io URL
Uses barcode scanning for inventory management
Dynamic pricing calculation based on per-gram/per-kg rates
known_issues: Payment gateway integration encountered build errors
OTP sign-in and location features caused previous build failures
